newCharacters.name: Hong Hong candied-fruit friend
newCharacters.appearance: Ruby fruits in crackly glass sugar.

newCharacters.name: Xia Xia shrimp-fishing guide
newCharacters.catchphrase: Patience reels in the good stuff.

newCharacters.name: Maccha-chan matcha whisk friend
newCharacters.appearance: Jade tea-spirit, whisk body, foam cap.

newCharacters.name: Deng Deng paper-lantern friend
newCharacters.appearance: Red lantern, soft glow, gold tassels.

newCharacters.name: Sa Sa spam-musubi friend
newCharacters.appearance: Rice block, nori belt, Spam slice.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Pack it neat, share it sweet.

stories.title: Boba and the Bubble-Tea Lesson
steps: Grown-up cooks tapioca pearls and coats them in brown sugar syrup; brew and cool milk tea
Layer pearls and tea over ice, shake, and sip
stories.premise: Boba and Coconut Jelly make boba milk tea.

stories.title: Bao Bao and the Sleepy Dough
steps: Foam yeast, mix with flour, salt, oil, knead, and let it rise twice into a loaf
Grown-up bakes it golden; cool, then slice
stories.premise: Bao Bao and Red Bean make bread.

stories.title: Bing and the Shaved Snow
steps: Freeze water or milk; grown-up shaves a fluffy mountain (sharp blade)
Pile on fruit, red bean, mochi, drizzle milk, eat fast
stories.premise: Bing and Mango make shaved ice.

stories.title: Hong Hong and the Glass Lanterns
steps: Wash and dry fruit, skewer it; grown-up boils sugar to hard-crack (VERY hot)
Roll skewers in syrup, cool on an oiled tray, then crunch
stories.premise: Hong Hong and Boba make bing tang hu lu.

stories.title: Niu Niu and the Warming Bowl
steps: Grown-up browns beef and simmers it with ginger, soy, bean paste, water, and tomato until tender
Add bok choy, boil noodles, ladle broth over, and slurp
stories.premise: Niu Niu and a traveler make beef noodle soup.

stories.title: Niko and the Rolling Rice
steps: Grown-up cooks rice; fold in vinegar; press pillows with cucumber or roll on nori
Grown-up slices the roll; dip in soy, say itadakimasu
stories.premise: Niko and Tama make sushi.

stories.title: Tama and the Three Corners
steps: Cook and cool rice, wet salted hands, dent it, and tuck in plum or tuna
Press into a triangle, wrap a nori strip, and eat or pack
stories.premise: Tama and Sa Sa make onigiri.

stories.title: Rin and the Happy Slurp
steps: Grown-up warms broth with miso or soy tare; soft-boil an egg; boil noodles
Ladle broth over noodles, top with egg, scallion, nori, and slurp
stories.premise: Rin and Tea Egg make ramen.

stories.title: Tako and Yaki and the Flip Game
steps: Whisk batter; grown-up oils the dimpled pan, fills it, adds octopus and scallion
Turn each with a skewer until round, top with sauce, eat hot
stories.premise: Tako and Yaki and Egg Waffle make takoyaki.

stories.title: Tai and the Batter Fish
steps: Stir batter; grown-up heats the fish mold, fills it, adds bean paste, more batter, and closes it
Cook golden, pop out, and bite the tail
stories.premise: Tai and Red Bean and Dora make taiyaki.

stories.title: Momo and the Pounding Night
steps: Steam mochiko paste until glossy (grown-up helps); dust with starch and flatten rounds
Add bean paste, seal into balls, dust off, and share
stories.premise: Momo and Mochi make mochi.

stories.title: Feng and the Gift Boxes
steps: Grown-up simmers pineapple jam, roll balls; make dough of butter, sugar, egg, flour
Wrap a ball, press a mold; grown-up bakes; cool, wrap, give
stories.premise: Feng and Bao Bao make pineapple cake.

stories.title: Cong Cong and the Flaky Spiral
steps: Roll a dough thin, brush oil, add scallions, roll a rope, coil a spiral, flatten
Grown-up pan-fries golden; cut and eat hot
stories.premise: Cong Cong and Digua make scallion pancake.

stories.title: Tang Yuan and the Soup Family
steps: Knead rice flour and warm water and roll smooth balls (optionally sesame inside)
Grown-up boils them till they float; serve in ginger syrup
stories.premise: Tang Yuan makes rice balls.

stories.title: Douhua and the Silky Wobble
steps: Grown-up pours warm soy milk from up high onto gelatin-water; do not stir; set 15 min
Make ginger syrup; scoop sheets, ladle syrup, enjoy the wobble
stories.premise: Douhua and Soy Milk make tofu pudding.

stories.title: Dan and the Grid of Gold
steps: Whisk batter and rest; grown-up heats the iron, pours, closes, and flips it
Cook golden, fold into a cone, and gobble
stories.premise: Dan and Mango make egg waffle.

stories.title: Zhima and the Big Roll
steps: Make dough, tuck in bean paste, seal, roll in water then sesame
Grown-up fries, pressing so they puff; drain and crunch
stories.premise: Zhima and Red Bean make sesame balls.

stories.title: Cao and the Jelly Garden
steps: Grown-up simmers the herb, strains it, stirs in cornstarch slurry, simmers thick
Cool until it sets; cut cubes, serve cold with milk or boba
stories.premise: Cao and Coconut Jelly make grass jelly.

stories.title: Xia Xia and the Shrimp Pond
steps: Grown-up threads the bait; lower the line, hold still, and watch the float
When it dips, lift; grown-up unhooks it; grill to share
stories.premise: Xia Xia and Boba go shrimp fishing.

stories.title: The Dumpling Pleat-Party
steps: Mix pork filling; spoon onto a wrapper, wet the rim, fold, and pinch pleats
Grown-up boils or pan-fries; dip in soy-vinegar
stories.premise: Xiao Long leads dumpling making.

stories.title: Maccha-chan and the Froth
steps: Sift matcha; grown-up heats water (not boiling); pour a little and whisk in a W until foamy
Add the rest of the water, sip slowly, feel calm
stories.premise: Maccha-chan and Dora make matcha.

stories.title: Mala and the Sugar Cloud
steps: Foam yeast in milk, mix dough, rise, cut rounds, and let puff
Grown-up fries in hot oil till golden; roll in sugar
stories.premise: Mala and Boba make malasadas.

stories.title: Sa Sa and the Rice Pillow
steps: Grown-up fries and glazes Spam; press warm rice in a mold over nori, lay Spam on top
Wrap the nori around, pack snug, and share
stories.premise: Sa Sa and Coconut Jelly make spam musubi.

stories.title: Dora and the Two Moons
steps: Whisk batter; grown-up pours pancake puddles and flips when bubbles pop
Spread bean paste on one and press a second on top
stories.premise: Dora and Tai make dorayaki.

stories.title: Gan Zhe and the Squeeze
steps: Rinse cane; grown-up peels, cuts, and presses it to catch the green juice
Strain out fibers, pour over ice, and gulp
stories.premise: Gan Zhe and Mango make sugarcane juice.

stories.title: Deng Deng and the Lantern
steps: Fold red paper, cut lines from the fold, unfold into strips, roll a tube and tape
Add a handle, decorate, and add a battery tea-light (no flame)
stories.premise: Deng Deng and Starfruit make a paper lantern.

stories.title: Digua and the Charcoal Cart
steps: Scrub potatoes, poke holes, wrap in foil; grown-up roasts in a hot oven an hour
Split to show the gold; eat plain or with butter
stories.premise: Digua and Bao Bao roast sweet potato.

stories.title: Hong Dou and the Bean Bowl
stories.howToMake: sweet red bean soup with grass jelly
steps: Soak beans; grown-up boils and simmers them till soft; add sugar, mash a few
Cut grass jelly into bowls and ladle the warm soup over
stories.premise: Hong Dou and Cao make red bean soup.

stories.title: Boba and the Flying Pearls
steps: Grown-up cooks and sweetens pearls; blend fruit with ice
Spoon pearls in, pour slush over, add milk, cap, shake, sip
stories.premise: Boba and friends make a boba slushie.

stories.title: The Grand Good-Night Kitchen
steps: Teams at stations make milk tea, dumplings, tangyuan, waffles, mochi, and shaved ice
Carry every dish to one table, say wanan, and share
stories.premise: All friends make a shared feast.

languageNote: Mixed: Mandarin / Japanese / Hawaiian per dish
